per_candidate.id: s2:Disequilibrium Chemistry in Exoplanet Atmospheres Observed with the Hubble Space

rationale: Paper 2103.07185 directly investigates the effects of vertical mixing and disequilibrium chemistry on the infrared absorption features of exoplanet atmospheres, contributing substantive evidence to part of the question. However, it does not fully resolve the role of dust in reconciling discrepancies between near-infrared and mid-infrared observations.
